data.one_liner: Flutter library for iOS WidgetKit extensions and communication.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to call essential methods from the iOS WidgetKit framework such as reloading timelines. It also enables data communication with native widgets via App Groups and UserDefaults.
use_when: You are building iOS widgets in SwiftUI and need to update timelines from your Flutter app.
You need to share data between your Flutter app and iOS widgets using App Groups and UserDefaults.
avoid_when: You want to build the UI of the iOS widgets entirely in Flutter (widgets themselves must be developed natively in SwiftUI).
You are targeting Android-only or non-iOS platforms.
strengths: Simplifies iOS WidgetKit timeline reloading from Flutter.
Provides key-value communication with native iOS widgets via App Groups.
weaknesses: Widgets themselves must still be developed natively in SwiftUI.
Limited strictly to iOS WidgetKit functionality.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up iOS App Groups and building the native SwiftUI widgets separately.
